_comment: Bootstrap manifest fetched by the desktop client at startup to discover the current update-server URL. This file is hosted at a fixed location (GitHub raw + GitHub Pages mirror). Editing it lets us relocate the update infrastructure without shipping a new client build.

update_server._comment_url: Replace with your production update-server domain. The client will hit {url}/api/v1/updates/{target}/{arch}/{current_version} for version checks and {url}/download/... for package retrieval.

_comment_min_client_version: Optional floor on client version. If the running client is older than this, the client should prompt the user to manually upgrade (bootstrap itself can't update the client — only the update-server can, and very old clients might not speak the current protocol).
